prior_work.title: One-Hot News: Drug Synergy Models Shortcut Molecular Features
prior_work.authors: Candir E.B., Kuru H.I., Rattray M., Cicek A.E., Tastan O.

what_their_abstract_says: replacing drug and cell line representations with simple one-hot encodings gives comparable or slightly improved performance across diverse published models
so the models use these representations primarily as identifiers and exploit covariation in the synergy labels
on synthetic data models can learn from true features, but recurring drugs and cell lines impair feature-based learning
current models can still aid in prioritizing DRUG PAIRS within a panel of tested drugs and cell lines
the field needs better strategies to learn from intended features and generalize to unseen drugs and cell lines

the_overlap_is_closer_than_I_assumed.C141: my measured boundary, that the model ranks combinations and not cells, is already present in their abstract as the scope remark of point four. I did not originate it; I measured it to 1.4e-17.
the_overlap_is_closer_than_I_assumed.one_hot_dominance: their first and second points are the phenomenon by name
the_overlap_is_closer_than_I_assumed.seen_drugs_need: their fifth point names unseen drugs as the open problem

what_remains_as_the_difference.1_shape: they report one-hot as comparable or better; I measured the split as a STEP: the annotation contributes exactly +0.0000 when identity is available and +0.118 when both drugs are unseen
what_remains_as_the_difference.2_controls: they attribute the effect to label covariation; I verified the structural reading independently with permuted drug-to-pathway maps, same-dimensional random blocks and dead blocks, and measured the effect as graded in content correctness
what_remains_as_the_difference.3_which_annotation: they do not compare annotation kinds; I found pathway beats target in both model families and under tissue holdout, with no increment from adding target
what_remains_as_the_difference.4_boundary_measured: they state pair prioritisation as a remaining capability; I turned it into a measurement (within-pair spread 1.4e-17, fraction varying 0.000)
what_remains_as_the_difference.5_cost: they call for better strategies; I put a price on verifying any of them, about 1,600 measurements, insensitive to allocation

one_sentence_positioning: they identify the division of labour and its cause; this programme measured the shape of that division, controlled it against matched nulls, bounded what the model cannot do, and priced the verification

an_honest_risk.what: their full text may already quantify the step shape or the verification cost
an_honest_risk.why_it_matters: those two are exactly where I claim the difference, so they are the most likely to be covered
an_honest_risk.status: cannot be checked from this machine: only the abstract is reachable
